items.headline: [D] Benchmarking Deep RL Stability Capable of Running on Edge Devices
items.summary: This post details my exploration for a "stable stack" for streaming deep RL (ObGD, SparseInit, LayerNorm, and online normalization) using 433,000 observations of real, non-stationary SSH attack traffic. Learnings From Tests:  Computational Efficiency: Using JAX's AOT compilation pipeline and cost_analysis(), the tests measure the per-update FLOP counts. An MLP with two hidden layers of 128 nodes each learner requires 271k FLOPs per update, capable of processing 477k observations/second
